metadata.name: ManualAuth
metadata.description: Use this API to perform manual authorizations (MTI 0100,0200,0220,0120,0400) by providing account details, card details, and transaction details. The API returns the approval code and transaction ID if manual authorization is approved.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: CardSequenceNumber
request_fields.description: Card Sequence Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03 Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: MerchantType
request_fields.description: Merchant Type. Example : 3021=Air Algerie Please refer Appendix Merchant Type. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: MerchantCity
request_fields.description: Merchant City Valid Values: a-z, A-Z Example:Atlanta Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: Invoice Number for Transaction Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example: AB987567757 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorIDCode
request_fields.description: Card Acceptor ID Code Valid Values:0-9 Example:123654789654123 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
request_fields.description: Name and location details of merchant Valid Values: a-z A-Z Example: Dental merchant, Nashua Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

request_fields.name: TransactionDescription
request_fields.description: Description of transaction Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Load Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: TransmissionDateTime
request_fields.description: Date and Time of transaction. Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/11/2020 11:00:00

request_fields.name: ResponseCode
request_fields.description: Result of API processing. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 00 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: PreAuthorizationAging
request_fields.description: If no matching completion/settlement record is received in this defined time then authorization hold will be released by the system. Valid Values:1 to 9 Format:XX Example:5" Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: PreAuthorizationAgingFrame
request_fields.description: Time Frame for PreAuthorization Aging in Days/Hours/Minutes Valid Values: 1 : Minutes, 2 :Hours, 3 :Days Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: AuthorizationType
request_fields.description: Type of transaction Valid Values :  0100 : Authorization Request 0200 : Financial Request 0220 Completion 0420 Reversal Example : 0100 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: ApprovalCode
request_fields.description: Approval Code of a transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Example:632563

request_fields.name: CoreAuthTranIdRev
request_fields.description: Transaction id  of  transaction to be reversed. Valid Values:0-9 Example:457896 Condition : Mandatory when AuthorizationType = 0420

request_fields.name: WalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:Mandatory when card product structure is multi wallet.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting description of transaction Example:Approved Allowable Values: 100

children.name: InternalResponseCode
children.description: Internal Response code Valid Values:   0-9 Example: 00,55 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseCode
children.description: Result of API processing. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 00 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ApprovalCode
children.description: Approval Code of a transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Example:632563 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: RetrievalRefNumber
children.description: Unique Reference Number assigned to transaction Example : 012541 Allowable Values: 12

children.name: SystemTraceAuditNumber
children.description: Unique number captured in request used for identification of transaction. Valid values : 0-9 Example:1050741741741417

children.name: AuthStatus
children.description: This field indicates the authorization Status. Valid Values: Refer Appendix section Authorization Status Example: 1 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: EmbAcctId
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MessageIndicator
children.description: Manual Auth message indicator Valid Values : 1,3 1 - when AuthorizationType = 0100 or 0420 3 - when AuthorizationType = 0220 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TranType
children.description: Transaction Code which indicates type of transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Format:1238 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PurgeDate
children.description: Date after which transaction will not be displayed in coreissue authrization log panel. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: TranCodeInternal
children.description: Internal Transaction code generated by system Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 5896 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: CoreAuthTranId
children.description: Transaction identifier of CoreAuth module Valid values : 0-9 Example:1050741741741417 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CalcOTB
children.description: Available Balance of account Valid Values:0-9 Example : 100.00

children.name: InvoiceNumber
children.description: Invoice Number for Transaction Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Example: AB987567757 Allowable Values: 10
